participation.context: Admitted the counting, took the one sentence, and did not pretend to the rest.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the lost hour, the Mayor's door, the loaf, and the threepence, and denied the dropped voice.
participation.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

participation.context: Gave the sentence about the steward and would not have the heads invented on the way home.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

participation.context: Left by the south door from three rows ahead, and did not speak.
participation.name: Sir John Spencer

relations.quote: I heard the finger on Friday, Mistress.

relations.note: three rows ahead, no word between them

story.body: You came out after the sermon on the unjust steward. Sir John went out from three rows ahead and did not turn. You told Mistress Ansell and Master Thwaite that you had been counting shoes, your father's small debts, and a horse at Lent. He gave you the sentence about goods not yet in the hand. She named a servant of Crosby Place and denied that she had lowered her voice. She also told you the loaf is still a penny and a finger short. You went back toward the house with the half of one sentence.

relations.quote: I heard the finger on Friday, Mistress.

title: Stood in the porch and kept half a sentence

participation.context: Spoke the memo and stopped on the order.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named in the attempt. Not in the room.
participation.name: Master Josias Thwaite

relations.quote: Goods not yet in his hand.

story.body: You tried the sermon back and kept one shard of Master Thwaite's sentence. You told yourself to attend properly next Sunday, and you stopped.

relations.quote: Goods not yet in his hand.

title: Tried the sermon back and kept one shard

participation.context: Stopped. Not pictured. Did not go in.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Heard, as the playing. Not named, and not seen as a face.
participation.name: the lady of the parish

story.body: You looked up at the gold window and the bent head, and you stayed in the lane. You are not in the picture.
topics: a house you do not know

title: Stopped in the lane for the pavan

participation.context: Made the cross and did not gloss it.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You set a small cross by the 5 and left the rest of the line empty. You did not write a name or a street.

title: Marked the fifth with a cross
